name: Pole Position II
notes: This board was withheld from the previous batch and is publishable now only because harvest() drops a contested cell instead of taking whichever reading came last. Its parts list claims 8 cell(s) twice.

Pole Position II's manual is a conversion-kit supplement (CO-218-12) whose prose is largely 'See Figure X in TM-218', and its figure headings OCR into fragments the FIGURE regex cannot anchor on. So the rows cannot be attributed to a PCB, and the 8 contested cells are simply dropped rather than split by figure.
Column-first designators, recorded in grid.transposed rather than inferred.
No component-location drawing has been read. The grid spacing is nominal.
conflicts: 8 designator(s) dropped as claimed twice within the one printing — with a single printing there is nothing to arbitrate with. They are listed by the merge and reproduced in the commit.

MAME's ROM map for this machine was NOT applied. MAME names each ROM by the board it sits on, and this hardware is more than one board: 9 of MAME's positions land on cells this map has, and all 9 hold logic here. Same hardware family as Pole Position, same conclusion. The site's MAME ROM-map page for the machine is unaffected — it never claimed a PCB — but nothing from it is placed on this map until someone attributes MAME's positions to a board.
